description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator class, which provides additional methods to manipulate and access PerformanceTrackerLog objects, such as formatting date fields and setting related entities like Employee, User, and PerformanceTracker by their identifiers. It acts as a decorator around the PerformanceTrackerLog entity, enhancing its functionality within the OrangeHRM performance tracking module.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing helper methods for PerformanceTrackerLog entity instances, including date formatting and setting related entities such as Employee, User, and PerformanceTracker.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTrackerLog object.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Returns the underlying PerformanceTrackerLog entity instance.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted 'added date' of the log entry.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the formatted 'modified date' of the log entry.

methods.name: setReviewerByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the log as reviewer by employee number.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Associates a User entity with the log based on user ID.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerById
methods.description: Links a PerformanceTracker entity to the log via its ID.
